blocks.text: Deferred Reflection
stress · Location trademark
A reflection arrives late and continues a gesture after the pet stops.
Location: The River of Deferred Reflections

Appearance: The upright pet takes on a translucent blue reflection appearance, while the upside-down image below becomes solid and keeps the original character colors. The solid lower image holds a real earlier pose, then catches up through recorded frames in 0.7 seconds. Both use the character’s actual artwork and facing.
Care: Use calm care, rest and the stress treatment listed in Care.
Story connection: A river artist could ask whose delayed gesture is still waiting to be seen.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.
Visual type: Effect

Mild / moderate / severe: the solid lower image holds for 1.25 / 2 / 3 seconds in a 4 / 5 / 6 second cycle and becomes larger. The upright image fades to 70% / 62% / 54% opacity. Reduced motion holds a fixed presentation.
